palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or sequence of characters that reads the same backward as forward. Here's a palindrome with more than 255 characters:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam, noon sees level deed, ere re, Eve, Able was I saw Elba, Able was I saw Elba, ere re, noon sees level deed, malayalam, teaches Arora Madam"

This sentence contains the word "palindrome," and when read in reverse, it forms another palindrome. It's not only long but also includes common phrases and words that make it more interesting to read and understand.
